title: Cloudflare Tunnel /api/* Routes Not Configured
summary: POST https://zenmidi.com/api/push-news returns 404 because the Cloudflare tunnel dashboard has not been configured with /api/* ingress rules. The tunnel is dashboard-managed (not file-based), and currently only routes /vn-market/* and /gateway/* paths.
root_cause: Cloudflare tunnel configuration is managed via Cloudflare dashboard, not via local config.yml. Dashboard config only has 2 routes: /vn-market → localhost:3000, /gateway → localhost:4040. The /api/* ingress rule needed to route VPS push endpoints (push-news, push-prices, push-sbv-rates, push-foreign-flow) to MCP server (localhost:3000) is missing.

steps_taken: 1. Verified localhost:3000/api/push-news works (returns 401 for missing auth, confirming endpoint exists)
3. Tested https://zenmidi.com/vn-market/health (returns 200, confirming tunnel is connected)
4. Found local config.yml was being ignored; cloudflared loads dashboard-managed configuration
5. Dashboard config in remote: only /vn-market and /gateway rules, /gateway points to wrong port (4040 vs 4000)

steps: 1. Login to Cloudflare dashboard → zenmidi.com tunnel
2. Add ingress rule: hostname=zenmidi.com, path=/api/*, service=http://localhost:3000
3. Place rule BEFORE the catch-all (default) rule
4. Fix /gateway rule: change service from http://localhost:4040 to http://localhost:4000
5. Save and wait for tunnel update
remediation.ac_after_fix: curl -X POST https://zenmidi.com/api/push-news -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"items":[]}' → HTTP 401 (correct auth required, not 404)
